chapter: Louis Armstrong picture, Kid Rena record and Bunk
title: Bunk Johnson teaching Rene's brother for a bottle of wine
summary: Rene recalls Bunk Johnson, a wine drinker who gave his brother ideas on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Oh, something else I was going to ask you about. Uh-huh. And that was...

Oh yeah, I knew Bunk, sure. You know Bunk, sure, my brother plenty of it. And you know what he used to teach him for? A 10 cent bottle of wine. That's all. Did Bunk drink? Yeah, he'd drink wine. He was a wine drinker. He was one of the finest men I ever seen, man. He'd come and cook red beans and stuff like that, and Bunk would stay there all day with that horn. But boy, you know Bunk made some nice stuff on the horn? Played some nice horn. Up Johnson.
So he taught your brother wine, huh?

Yeah, he'd give him, yeah, he'd give him, give him some ideas. Yeah, he'd be around him plenty. Old Robinson, boy, old Jim. Boy, he's got all the trombone playing by any style of the day. That's sad. That's something, boy, you... Got some old pictures here, huh? You like that book, huh? Yeah, yeah. Boy, it's fresh in my mouth.
